notes.title: March 29th 2025 Update:
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291545/2b763e1ef5ea90187a19d769e57a3abe8df60ad7.png[/img]

[b]World Map![/b]

The Spires of Morosith now span across three new environments! Defend the Kingdom’s Forests, the Floating Islands, and the Deadroot from the Grainwraith invasions.

A block out version of the world map is now useable. The goal with this map is to help visualize the progression you’re making through the game. 

The Survival Game Mode missions are on optional paths.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291545/dc121b9e35eb1e231b314106905219cd1ad872d1.png[/img]

[b]Critters![/b]

Some maps will have groups of critter roaming around. They’re mostly harmless. They’ll block the construction of new buildings, but can be scared away by building nearby.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291545/fd8d13f3af24c40205e5c305ab590b45cc5d9bd1.png[/img]

[b]Portals![/b]

The Grainwraiths have established some portal networks to warp from point to point. They’re dangerous, but maybe the portals can be used to your benefit.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291545/d1c955ca6f23ad1213dcc2007c9c558f0d2cb3ac.png[/img]

[b]Deadroot & Heartwood[/b]

In the third biome of the game, the trees are rotten and unusable Deadroot. However there are a few Heartwood trees that stand tall. The Heartwood have many more wood resources to start with (30) and regenerate over time. They cannot be completely harvested.

These missions require constant decision making. Spend your gatherer’s time to clear the Deadroot granting more building space, or send them to harvest resources from the Heartwood.



[b]Difficulty Adjustments.[/b]

Shifted the Enemy Health scaling from pre-Wave increases, to increase over time.
For example, an enemy’s health would increase by 10% each wave, but now the enemies will gain 10% HP every minute.

The current enemy health scaling factor is available when hovering the Wave display in game.

Forests now have 4 Wood instead of 2. The trade off here is that you’ll have slightly more wood early game, but need to be more strategic with maze building as the map space wont open up as quickly.

The benefits of the Blacksmith and Shrine have been reduced slightly, and brought inline with one another. Blacksmith will provide additional resources, while the Shrine will help your gatherers harvest faster, allowing you to open the map more quickly.

There are a lot of new maps, and this difficulty adjustment is large. I need all the feedback I can get on the pre-existing Forest maps as well as the new Floating Islands and Deadroot maps!



[b]Bug Fixes & Adjustments[/b]

Gatherers should no longer stick to one another when trying to deposit or harvest wood.

Towers and Buildings should always affect the path.

No more invisible Towers and Buildings.

Trojan Grainwraiths have had their spawners power reduced by a large amount of Challenge Rating.

Grainwraiths base health pools increased, especially the specials, and fewer are spawned each wave.

Reduced Bannermen Grainwraith healing frequency and amount of health recovered.

Buildings can now be sold. Selling Blacksmiths will remove levels from gatherers, selling Shrines will NOT restart the Spirit timers, no cheesing!

A number of previously existing maps have had their layouts altered, resource nodes moved around.

Gatherer Harvesting queues will properly update while the game is paused, allowing you to plan their harvesting route at your leisure.

Building Towers will no longer count the Gatherers as Actors, allowing you to box them in. This is good, i swear!

Remove Blueprints button moved out of the way of the Buildings buttons.

Thralls have had their movement speed increased by almost 100%. They were too slow, not too exciting of a wave.

Gatherers no longer go ‘Idle’ when the game is over, and will resume their previous action if you decide to continue in Endless mode.

Tower and Building unlock pop-ups now correctly resize to fully display the descriptions.

Flame Tower Damage increased by ~30%. Trying to bring this tower in line with the output provided by the Gem Towers and Void Towers.

A Gold-per-Minute text has been added to the Wood Bank tooltip. This could help benchmark economy performance. (Hover over how much wood you have to view it)

Fixed an issue where you could hover over UI elements and see tooltips for 3d World elements.

Added a simple training mission, accessible by a button in the top-left of the World Map.



[b]Finally, Thank you! [/b]

Receiving player feedback, ideas, tales of success and defeat is one of my favorite parts of the game development journey. Thanks again for spending your time and energy in the Spires of Morosith playtest!

notes.title: February 21st 2025 Update:
notes.content:
Bug Squashing:
- Improved Camera clamping to the gameplay space, to prevent the camera drifting off to somewhere not useful.
- Cleaned up UI sorting and positioning so that it does not clip the 3d environment.
- Adjusted Gem Tower missile speeds a bit to prevent the death spirals.
- Dilation Tower's Dome effect should properly position and turn on/off.
- The Thrall Ooze should now properly be removed, and re-activate the towers they've deactivated.
- Returning from a cutscene should no longer put you in a bad gameplay state.
- Fixed a building placement bug that would prevent Shrines/Blacksmiths/Mana Wells from being placed.
- Building Placement graphics will now consistently render above the Water plane.
- Many bug fixes implemented for the Trojan Enemy spawners.
- Fixed a collision issue with the Vanguard shields.

New or Improved:
- Victory, Endless Mode, and Defeat flows added to the game.
- Bosses now award up to 30 Cores, regardless of Obelisk distance.
 - This reward is reduced per Damage taken by the boss. Ex; if you have 5 health and take 1 damage, you receive 80% of the reward. (4remaining hp / 5hp)
- Abhorration boss HP Increased 150 -> 200.
- Abhorration boss Fire ball frequency increased from every 5th move to every 8th.
- Abhorration boss Strafe (burn trees) frequency increased from every 4th move to every 2nd move.
- Hover tooltips added for Menu/Play/Pause/FFW (shows the hotkey) and Wave (shows mission stats)
- Wave performance tracking and display added to the game.
 - A perfect wave is achieved by claiming all of the possible Cores that wave provides. If in endless mode, a perfect wave is defeating 100% of the spawned enemies.
 - Non perfect waves display the % of cores claimed, or % of enemies killed an endless mode wave.
 - At the top of the screen a star will appear for each wave. A yellow star is a perfect wave. A blue star is an imperfect wave score.
 - Perfect Wave Count is now tracked alongside the Highest Wave (endless) for each mission.
- Adjusting the HP scaling for enemies in mid-to-late waves. The goal is for endless to end between wave 50 and 75. This change probably wont be enough, let me know what waves you get to!

notes.title: February 12th 2025 Update:
notes.content:
[b]Bug Squashing:[/b]
- Towers are properly disposed when sold in pause mode, preventing infinite money from selling the tower repeatedly.
- Units should seek new paths if they end up in a cell with an object, instead of circling the object indefinitely.
- A few items have received tooltip updates to create consistency in language. (Ex, the Spire's repairing function said "Castle Repairing")
- Projectiles should properly arrive at targets and be removed from the scene.
- Unit VFX should all appear below/behind UI elements.
- The Gatherer's shrine buff VFX now disables when they're no longer buffed.
- Tower placement colors now update periodically when paused.

[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Spent a lot of last week focusing on performance, in hopes to getting endless mode running smoothly. Let me know how it goes!
- Tower placement now draws the cell below the tower always, and the tower's range indicator will also tint yellow/red when you can or cannot place the tower.
- Many towers and enemies have had a refresh on their VFX set.
- Tower placement now has a VFX.
- The unlock mechanic for towers and buildings has had a tooltip and UI pass with the goal of communicating and celebrating the unlocking.
- Many missions have had their camera padding increased so that it is easier to select towers at the bottom of a mission and access their sell/upgrade options.
- Shrine spirits will now stay within a specified range of the Shrine, and hopefully not get lots or occluded by things as much.
- Slightly increased the difficulty ramp for late-game waves (Waves 30+).
- Improved Quest legibility, updating their UI.

notes.title: January 30th 2025 Update:
notes.content:
[b]NEW GAME MODE: Survival missions[/b].

I wanted to create some variation in the missions presented in Spires of Morosith. In Survival missions the Grainwraiths spawn constantly from one or many larger Tears in the Gossamer. 

Looking for feedback on how these missions played. 
- How did you approach the puzzle? 
- What did you try that failed, what did you try that worked? 
- Did the survival missions present a different experience from the standard missions?
- Was there anything you hated?
- Anything you wanted more of?

The missions are listed in mission selection below the standard missions in an ‘experimental box’. These missions are unlocked by default so you can get into them more easily.

Survival missions are intended to be tough, so I’ve also added an ‘unlock all’ button to the mission select which will unlock all the missions, towers, and buildings.

You may encounter some new enemies within the survival missions.



[b]BUGS / ADJUSTMENTS: [/b]

- Adjusted Standard Mission 2’s difficulty.
- Fixed Gatherer resource selection, no longer selects un-pathable resource.
- Queueing a resource node while the Gatherer is carrying resources no distracts the Gatherer from depositing their harvest.
- Tower Select HUD now plays it’s animation while Paused.
- Hovering over the SELL button now previews path modifications.
- Double tapping Q or E will focus the camera on the selected Gatherer.
- Slight adjustments to the Upgrade Tower buttons.
- Slight adjustments to the Cost & Quantity labels for unbuildable structures.
- Reduced the Grainwraith hit-flash intensity.

Thanks for checking out Spires of Morosith!

notes.title: January 18th 2025 Update:
notes.content:
- Large art and audio pass.
- Ruins, Obelisk and economy iterations.
- Added a progression system for your arsenal of towers and buildings.
- Minor map layout changes to address wonky starting waves.
- A lasagna amount of bugs addressed.

notes.title: November 15th 2024 Update:
notes.content:
A slew of improvements, bug fixes and additions.

Menus
- Returning to menus from a completed mission will now place you in Mission Select.
- Options Menu no longer triggered during cutscene with [ESC].
- Cursor now confined to game window, allowing for better edge-panning in windowed mode.
- Many tooltip copy iterated on, spelling errors addressed.


Art Updates
- Spires, Obelisks and all Ruin types received visual updates.


Missions
- Removed 'Ready' button step. Mission begins when you command a gatherer to harvest.
- Added Endless mode. Can be triggered after achieving Victory. Endless Mode displays tracks and displays high scores. How long can you last?
- Increased Unit Health scaling. Let's see how challenging it is.
- Adding stones throughout all of the missions, should create some more texture to maze building.
- Redesigned Mission 4, finding the previous Obelisk and Spawner positions were a bit much to handle.
- Should no longer see ultra-wide currency or health toasts after taking Critical Damage.


Units
- Nightshade Siren's Thralls will now re-spawn with appropriate move speeds. (was 0)
- Thrall's ooze now properly dissolves, allowing you to play missions after defeating it.


Towers
- Gem tower properly determine damage on explosion (Was not triggering damage consistently).


MISC
- Began Steamworks integration with achievements in mind.

Reminder this is a playtest, all work is subject to change.
Your feedback is extremely valuable at this stage of the game!
